mapper.sql: emp09_evaluation_id AS evaluation_id, emp09_person_id AS person_id, TO_CHAR(emp09_evaluation_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS evaluation_dt, emp09_evaluation_org AS evaluation_org, emp09_evaluation_emp AS evaluation_emp, emp09_evaluation_grade AS evaluation_grade, emp09_evaluation_desc AS evaluation_desc, emp09_note AS note
mapper.select: SELECT FROM emp09_evaluation JOIN emp01_person ON emp09_person_id = emp01_person_id WHERE emp09_evaluation_id = #{evaluationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO emp09_evaluation ( emp09_evaluation_id, emp09_person_id, emp09_evaluation_dt , emp09_evaluation_org, emp09_evaluation_emp , emp09_evaluation_grade, emp09_evaluation_desc, emp09_note ) VALUES ( #{evaluationId}, #{req.personId}, #{req.evaluationDt}::date , #{req.evaluationOrg}, #{req.evaluationEmp} , #{req.evaluationGrade}, #{req.evaluationDesc}, #{req.note} )
